ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio of high-intensity white pixels (estimated <10%) to dominant low-intensity black pixels across the ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity black pigmentation across both lobes. Scattered high-contrast white circular/annular pixel clusters (mottling) localized predominantly on the right lobe and center-left region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression dividing the lobes; characterized by an acute angle at the apex with high pixel-depth into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous trailing boundary showing irregular, low-amplitude peaks and valleys; higher frequency serrations visible at the terminal tips of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobes exhibit a convex upward trajectory from the notch towards the lateral tips; outer boundaries show irregular curvature.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density constellation of white circular ring-shaped pixel clusters visible on the inner right lobe and sparse clusters on the inner left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct vertical linear disruption near the median notch showing orange-brown hues; faint horizontal linear pixel disruptions visible on the lower left lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent vertical linear feature (potential entanglement mark or trauma) crossing the fluke surface adjacent to the median notch.
other_distinctive_markers: A highly unique, high-contrast vertical linear mark with non-conforming pigmentation (orange-brown) located at the central notch junction.
